## VPS-rule editing and traffic selectors

- Config → Rules now preserves the exact typed or pasted draft while an input
  is focused. Supported values canonicalize only when focus leaves the field;
  invalid, unknown, malformed, and duplicate raw entries remain intact for the
  existing Preview/Apply validation instead of being silently rewritten or
  discarded.
- Traffic selectors accept `+rx+tx` and `+tx+rx` as aliases for the existing
  bare-interface RX+TX total. They also accept `+tx/rx` and `+rx/tx`,
  canonicalized as `+tx/rx`, to account the greater of RX and TX while keeping
  both directional values and diagnostic history visible.
- Aggregate live-rate selection accepts the same selector syntax but continues
  to keep separately reported RX and TX rates. VPS-card traffic summaries keep
  usage, quota, and percentage emphasized while rendering only the middle
  direction label at regular weight.

## API and operator changes

- Parsed selector JSON may now report `"direction": "tx/rx"`. For that explicit
  aggregation mode, accounted `total_bytes` and `latest_total_bytes` are the
  per-selector maximum and therefore need not equal accounted RX plus TX.
- No REST fields, database schema, telemetry collection, retained-history, or
  public-share visibility rules changed.
